title: The Absolute Anabelian Geometry of Virtual Curves of Arbitrary Genus
summary: The objective of this paper is to further study the anabelian object referred to as \emph{pointed virtual curves}. Building upon previous work that investigated these fundamental-group-theoretic pullbacks of Galois sections in the genus-zero situation, we extend the central anabelian results to curves of arbitrary genus. To facilitate this generalization, we introduce the group-theoretic notion of an inclusion of CAVC-type and the categorical-theoretic notion of a virtual decuspidaloid.
